entries.title: Psalms 137:1
segments: There we sat down by the rivers of Babylon; also, we wept when we remembered Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:2
segments: We hung our lyres on the willows in its midst.

entries.title: Psalms 137:3
segments: For there our captors demanded a song from us; and our plunderers [demanded] gladness, [saying], Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:4
segments: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a foreign land?

entries.title: Psalms 137:5
segments: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget.

entries.title: Psalms 137:6
segments: If I do not remember you, let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth; if I do not prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

entries.title: Psalms 137:7
segments: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Make [it] bare! Make [it] bare, even to the foundation of [it]!

entries.title: Psalms 137:8
segments: O daughter of Babylon, O destroyed one! Blessed [is] he who will repay to [you] your reward which you rewarded to us.

entries.title: Psalms 137:9
segments: Blessed [is] he who seizes and dashes your little ones against the stones.
